text:
Predicates:
IstanbulPlate(x) ::: x is a vehicle registration plate from Istanbul.
BeginsWith34(x) ::: x begins with the number 34.
BeginsWith35(x) ::: x begins with the number 35.
JoePlate(x) ::: x is Joe's vehicle registration plate.
TomPlate(x) ::: x is Tom's vehicle registration plate.
FOL ::: ∀x (IstanbulPlate(x) → BeginsWith34(x))
FOL ::: ∀x (¬BeginsWith34(x) → ¬IstanbulPlate(x))
FOL ::: ∃x (JoePlate(x) ∧ IstanbulPlate(x))
FOL ::: ∃x (TomPlate(x) ∧ BeginsWith35(x))
FOL ::: ∀x (BeginsWith35(x) → ¬BeginsWith34(x))
Conclusion:
∃x (JoePlate(x) ∧ BeginsWith34(x)) ::: Joe's license plate begins with the number 34.
